steps.verify: Compare before and after counts in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if the reconciliation shows zero lost items across the session.

steps.title: Archive the snapshots with the decision record
steps.sop: The Product Owner exports the before/after board snapshots and the reprioritization decision notes, tagged with the sprint/PI id and UTC timestamp, retained 12 months, and confirms the rerank; ranking disputes are resolved by the Product Owner as decision authority, with unresolvable strategic conflicts escalated to the portfolio Monthly Review. Done when the tagged evidence is archived with the confirmation.
steps.verify: Open the archived cadence record; pass if before/after snapshots and decision notes exist with sprint/PI tag and timestamp, and the Product Owner's confirmation is recorded.

steps.title: Compile the full re-test queue
steps.sop: The QA Analyst compiles the queue of all defects in status 'Ready for Re-test' for the current release train in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira) — 100% of fixed defects are re-tested, never sampled. Done when the queue covers every defect moved to 'Fixed' since the last re-test cycle.
steps.verify: Run the 'Ready for Re-test' query in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if the queue contains every returned defect for the release train with none omitted.

steps.title: Verify the fix commit is in the re-test build
steps.sop: The QA Analyst verifies for each defect in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira) that the fix commit SHA in the re-tested build (release candidate tag rc-x.y.z) matches the merged PR linked on the defect. Done when every queued defect's fix is confirmed present in the build.
steps.verify: For each defect in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira), compare the linked PR's commit SHA to the rc build contents; pass if every fix commit is present in the build under test.

steps.title: Execute the re-test for each defect
steps.sop: The QA Analyst executes one re-test per defect against the rc build, confirming the failing pre-fix behavior no longer reproduces and the documented expected result is observed. Done when every queued defect has an executed re-test with a verdict.
steps.verify: Review the executions linked in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if each defect has exactly one re-test execution recording that the original failure no longer reproduces.

steps.title: Re-run the affected module regression suite
steps.sop: The Backend Developer and UI Developer re-run the regression suite for each affected module on the fixed build. Done when the regression runs complete with 0 new failures.
steps.verify: Open the regression results for the affected modules; pass if every run against the rc build completed with zero new failures.

steps.title: Record the re-test evidence on each defect
steps.sop: The QA Analyst records on each defect in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira): defect key, build/tag re-tested against, test case ID, actual result, pass/fail verdict, tester, and timestamp, attaching execution log, screenshots, and console/API output stamped with the build tag; evidence is retained 12 months per release. Done when no record is saved without a linked test-case execution.
steps.verify: Open each re-tested defect in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if all seven fields are populated and the attached evidence carries the build tag and UTC timestamp.

steps.title: Reconcile executions to the fixed-defect count
steps.sop: The QA Analyst reconciles the count of defects marked 'Fixed' at cycle start to the count of re-test executions recorded in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira). Done when the delta is 0; any un-re-tested 'Fixed' defect blocks the release gate.
steps.verify: Compare the cycle-start 'Fixed' count to the execution count in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if the delta is zero or the gate shows a block for any gap.

steps.title: Disposition non-passing re-test outcomes
steps.sop: The QA Analyst re-opens each failed defect in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira), assigning it back to the fixing developer with the 'reopened' label and logging it in the release exception register; blocked/untestable items get a 'test-blocked' ticket with owner and target date resolved within 2 business days or escalated to the Release Manager. Done when every non-pass outcome is dispositioned.
steps.verify: Search 'reopened' and 'test-blocked' items in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if every failed re-test is reopened to a developer and every blocked item has an owned ticket within the 2-business-day SLA.

steps.title: Close the re-test cycle for the build
steps.sop: The QA Analyst records cycle completion in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira), confirming 100% of re-tested defects PASS or are explicitly deferred with sign-off; results are valid only for the exact build tag re-tested — a new build supersedes the evidence and requires re-execution before release. Done when the cycle-close record is saved.
steps.verify: Open the cycle-close record in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if it shows all defects passed or deferred with sign-off and names the exact build tag the results apply to.

tasks.taskName: Refine backlog items to definition of ready

steps.title: Select the refinement candidates for the session
steps.sop: The Product Owner selects all stories/enablers slated for the next 2 sprints that are not yet marked 'Ready' on the team board in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps for the weekly refinement session. Done when the session list is set.
steps.verify: Run the not-Ready filter for the next 2 sprints in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if the session list matches the filter output.

steps.title: Record the story statement with acceptance criteria
steps.sop: The Business Analyst records a user-story statement and testable acceptance criteria on each candidate in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps. Done when every candidate carries both.
steps.verify: Audit the session candidates in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if each has a user-story statement and acceptance criteria that are testable.

steps.title: Estimate each story in the session
steps.sop: The Backend Developer and UI Developer estimate each story during refinement and record the estimate on the ticket in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps, confirming shared team understanding. Done when every candidate has an estimate.
steps.verify: Check the candidates in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if every story carries a recorded estimate entered during the session.

steps.title: Clear dependencies on each story
steps.sop: The Business Analyst identifies dependencies on each story in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps, links them on the ticket, and drives open blocking questions to resolution or a scheduled follow-up. Done when each story shows dependencies identified and 0 open blocking questions or a documented blocker with follow-up owner.
steps.verify: Open each story in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if dependency links are recorded and no unresolved blocking question exists without a documented blocker and owner.

steps.title: Gate the Ready transition on the DoR checklist
steps.sop: The Product Owner completes the board's DoR checklist on each story in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps and transitions qualifying stories to 'Ready'; the checklist gates the transition so no story is 'Ready' with an unmet DoR field. Done when the count of 'Ready' items reconciles with items passing all DoR fields.
steps.verify: Compare 'Ready' items to their DoR checklists in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if every 'Ready' story has statement, acceptance criteria, estimate, dependencies handled, and zero open blocking questions.

steps.title: Archive the refinement outcomes
steps.sop: The Business Analyst confirms refinement outcomes (estimates, split decisions) are recorded with timestamps on each story in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps and archives the session notes; items that cannot reach DoR stay in 'Refinement' with the documented blocker. Done when outcomes and notes are archived.
steps.verify: Review the session stories in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if each shows timestamped refinement outcomes and the session notes archive exists.

steps.title: Confirm the refined set for the sprint
steps.sop: The Product Owner confirms the refined set for the sprint in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; any story pulled into a sprint without meeting DoR is returned to the backlog and logged as a Jira 'AGILE-Exception' resolved within 1 business day. Done when the confirmation is recorded and no non-Ready story sits in the sprint.
steps.verify: Open the sprint scope in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if the Product Owner's confirmation exists and any DoR violation shows an 'AGILE-Exception' resolved within 1 business day.

tasks.taskName: Report coverage gaps to engineering leadership

steps.title: Score every service from the automated scans
steps.sop: The Software Engineer compiles the quarterly coverage data from the automated repo/docs scans, scoring each production service on: has-README (Y/N), has-runbook (Y/N), ADR count, doc last-updated date, and knowledge-owner count, flagging every critical component with bus-factor = 1. Done when every row is fully populated with no blanks.
steps.verify: Review the scored dataset; pass if every service row carries all five scores from the automated scans, no cell is blank, and single-owner components are flagged.

steps.title: Reconcile the service list to the service catalog
steps.sop: The Software Engineer reconciles the report's service count against the count of active services in the CMDB/service catalog. Done when variance is 0, or each missing service is listed as a data-quality note in the report.
steps.verify: Compare the report row count to the active-service catalog count; pass if the counts match or every discrepancy appears as a data-quality note.

steps.title: Mark data-pending services with a KM-Exception
steps.sop: The Software Engineer marks services whose data source was unavailable at report time as 'data-pending' and logs a 'KM-Exception' follow-up ticket owned by the Software Engineer, closed within 5 business days. Done when every unavailable-data service is marked and ticketed.
steps.verify: Search 'KM-Exception' tickets for the quarter; pass if each 'data-pending' service has a ticket with the Software Engineer as owner and a close date within 5 business days.

steps.title: Ticket every identified gap with an owner
steps.sop: The Tech Lead creates a 'DOC-Gap' backlog item for each identified gap with the owning team and a target quarter; gaps accepted as low-risk carry a documented rationale on the ticket. Done when every gap in the report has a ticket.
steps.verify: Cross-check report gaps to 'DOC-Gap' items; pass if each gap has a ticket naming the owning team and target quarter, and accepted gaps carry a rationale.

steps.title: Publish the quarterly report to Confluence
steps.sop: The Software Engineer publishes the coverage report to Confluence with the quarter label and generation timestamp before the quarter-close date, retained for 4 quarters for trend comparison. Done when the labeled report page is live inside the deadline.
steps.verify: Open the report page in Confluence; pass if it carries the quarter label and generation timestamp dated before quarter-close, with the prior quarters' reports retained.

steps.title: Obtain leadership acknowledgment on the report
steps.sop: The Tech Lead, as engineering leadership recipient (or the delegate named in the team charter if unavailable), acknowledges receipt via a comment on the Confluence report page. Done when the acknowledgment is recorded and each gap has an owner and target quarter.
steps.verify: Open the report page in Confluence; pass if a Tech Lead (or named delegate) acknowledgment comment exists and the gap list shows owners and target quarters throughout.

steps.title: Export the closed month intake records
steps.sop: The Business Analyst closes the reporting month on the 1st business day and exports all demand-intake requests (new features, changes, defects) for the prior calendar month from ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira), excluding spam/duplicate tickets already merged. Done when the dated export is captured.
steps.verify: Open the export from ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if it covers the full prior month, was cut on or after the 1st business day, and excludes merged duplicates.

steps.title: Validate required fields on the intake records
steps.sop: The Business Analyst validates in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira) that every intake record has: submitted date, request type, priority, requesting business unit, assigned team, and current status. Done when records missing type or priority are under 1% of the month's volume.
steps.verify: Profile the export fields; pass if all six fields are populated across the set and the missing type/priority rate is below 1%.

steps.title: Raise DATA-DEFECT tickets for data issues
steps.sop: The Business Analyst logs any reconciliation variance or null-key record as a Jira 'DATA-DEFECT' in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira) with disposition corrected-at-source or excluded-with-note before the report is issued; if figures do not reconcile the report is held and re-run within 1 business day of correction. Done when every data issue has a dispositioned ticket.
steps.verify: Search 'DATA-DEFECT' tickets for the month in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if each variance or null-key issue has a ticket with a disposition recorded before report issuance.

steps.title: Build the monthly dashboard in the BI platform
steps.sop: The Demand Manager builds the monthly report in BI/reporting platform showing intake volume, backlog aging buckets (0-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 90+ days), and the month-over-month trend. Done when all three views render from the warehouse data.
steps.verify: Open the dashboard in BI/reporting platform; pass if intake volume, the four aging buckets, and the MoM trend are all present for the reporting month.

steps.title: Reconcile the report totals to the ITSM source
steps.sop: The Business Analyst reconciles the BI/reporting platform totals to source: total intake count equals the ITSM export row count with 0 variance, backlog closing balance = opening balance + intake - closed, and aging buckets sum to the total backlog with no negative bucket. Done when all three checks pass.
steps.verify: Re-run the reconciliation against the ITSM export; pass if the intake count variance is zero, the balance equation holds, and the aging buckets sum correctly with none negative.

steps.title: Archive the versioned report snapshot
steps.sop: The Business Analyst saves the report PDF/dashboard snapshot from BI/reporting platform to the reporting repository with the month tag and UTC generation timestamp, with the underlying warehouse query and dataset version pinned; retained 24 months. Done when the tagged snapshot and query hash are stored.
steps.verify: Open the reporting repository entry for the month; pass if the snapshot carries month tag and timestamp and the pinned query/dataset version (hash) is stored alongside.

steps.title: Deliver the approved report to leadership
steps.sop: The Demand Manager approves the report and delivers the BI/reporting platform dashboard link and email to delivery leadership by the 3rd business day of the following month. Done when delivery is confirmed inside the deadline.
steps.verify: Check the delivery record; pass if the approved report reached delivery leadership on or before the 3rd business day with the dashboard URL included.

tasks.taskName: Report developer experience metrics to leadership

steps.title: Assemble the quarterly metrics in the BI platform
steps.sop: The Software Engineer assembles the quarter's developer-experience metrics in BI/reporting platform — DORA four keys (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR) computed per the standard definitions, plus PR cycle time, build success rate, and developer-survey scores — across all squads, computed over the exact quarter start/end dates stated in the report header. Done when all metric rows are loaded with no nulls.
steps.verify: Open the report dataset in BI/reporting platform; pass if all listed metrics are present for every squad over the stated quarter window with zero null reporting rows.

steps.title: Verify the metadata on every metric
steps.sop: The Software Engineer verifies each metric in BI/reporting platform carries a definition, source system, calculation window, unit, and target/benchmark. Done when no metric lacks any of the five metadata fields.
steps.verify: Audit the metric metadata in BI/reporting platform; pass if every metric row shows definition, source, window, unit, and target.

steps.title: Reconcile the report to the source extracts
steps.sop: The Software Engineer reconciles metric row counts and totals in BI/reporting platform to the source-system extracts (pipeline, Jira, survey tool), footing totals against the warehouse fact tables. Done when variance is at or under 1% on every metric.
steps.verify: Compare the report figures to the source extracts; pass if every metric reconciles within 1% and totals foot to the warehouse fact tables.

steps.title: Footnote gaps with SDLC-Exception tickets
steps.sop: The Software Engineer footnotes any metric with a data-quality gap or missing source in BI/reporting platform and logs a Jira 'SDLC-Exception' with a 10-business-day remediation SLA; a reconciliation break carries a 5-business-day SLA and must be resolved before the report is released. Done when every gap is footnoted and ticketed.
steps.verify: Review the report footnotes and open 'SDLC-Exception' tickets; pass if each gap has both a footnote and a ticket with owner and an SLA-compliant due date.

steps.title: Version the report snapshot for retention
steps.sop: The Software Engineer versions the report snapshot (BI export plus query definitions) from BI/reporting platform with the quarter tag, retained 24 months in the reporting repository with data lineage captured. Done when the tagged snapshot is archived.
steps.verify: Open the reporting repository; pass if the quarter-tagged snapshot exists with query definitions attached and lineage recorded.

steps.title: Deliver the approved quarterly report
steps.sop: The Platform Engineering Lead approves the report in BI/reporting platform and it is delivered to engineering leadership within 10 business days of quarter close. Done when the approval and delivery are both recorded inside the deadline.
steps.verify: Check the approval and delivery records; pass if the Platform Engineering Lead's approval is logged and leadership received the report within 10 business days of quarter close.

steps.title: Extract the quarter's governance gate records
steps.sop: The Software Engineer extracts all implementation-governance decisions and design-assurance gate outcomes for changes deployed in the reporting quarter, confirming each record carries: change ticket id, gate name, outcome (pass/conditional/fail), reviewer, date, and remediation status. Done when every record is complete.
steps.verify: Review the extracted records; pass if every gate record for the quarter contains all six required fields with no blanks.

steps.title: Reconcile records to deployed changes
steps.sop: The Software Engineer reconciles the number of governance records to the number of deployed changes requiring a gate in the period, verifying every record links to its change ticket id; unlinked records are a reconciliation defect and must be resolved before the report is finalized. Done when the variance is 0.
steps.verify: Compare the governance record count to the gated-change count; pass if the counts match with zero variance and every record carries a change ticket link.

steps.title: Disposition every gate failure or finding
steps.sop: The Software Engineer confirms each gate failure or unremediated finding carries a disposition (accepted / remediating / waived) with an owner and due date; waivers require ARB approval. Done when no finding lacks a disposition.
steps.verify: Review the findings list; pass if every failure shows a disposition, owner, and due date, and each waiver references an ARB approval.

steps.title: Compare current metrics to the prior quarter
steps.sop: The Software Engineer compares prior-quarter governance metrics against the current quarter — gate pass rate and mean remediation days — and explains variance and trend in the report narrative. Done when the comparison and explanation are drafted.
steps.verify: Read the comparison section; pass if both metrics are shown for both quarters and the narrative explains the variance and trend.

steps.title: Compose the versioned report in Confluence
steps.sop: The Software Engineer composes the governance outcomes report in Confluence versioned with the quarter tag (e.g. 'GovReport-2026Q2-v1'), attaching the underlying data export; report plus export are retained 7 years in the compliance evidence store. Done when the versioned page with attachment is complete.
steps.verify: Open the report page in Confluence; pass if it follows the 'GovReport-<quarter>-vN' versioning, includes the data export attachment, and states the 7-year retention.

steps.title: Resolve reporting discrepancies before sign-off
steps.sop: The Software Engineer resolves any discrepancy between the report and the underlying governance records within a 5-business-day remediation SLA before sign-off, logging the issue and fix on the report page in Confluence. Done when no unresolved discrepancy remains.
steps.verify: Check the report page issue log in Confluence; pass if every raised discrepancy shows a resolution dated within 5 business days and none is open at sign-off.

steps.title: Deliver the report with Tech Lead sign-off
steps.sop: The Tech Lead signs off the report on the Confluence page and it is delivered to technology leadership within 10 business days of quarter close. Done when sign-off and delivery are both recorded inside the deadline.
steps.verify: Open the report page in Confluence; pass if the Tech Lead's sign-off is recorded and the delivery to leadership is documented within 10 business days of quarter close.

tasks.taskName: Resolve blocking dependencies before sprint commitment

steps.title: Run the blocker-link report for sprint candidates
steps.sop: The Scrum Master runs the blocker-link report in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps listing every sprint-candidate story carrying one or more 'is blocked by' links during the refinement-to-planning window. Done when the report is saved as the filter 'Sprint Candidates - Open Blockers'.
steps.verify: Open the 'Sprint Candidates - Open Blockers' filter in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if it exists and returns every candidate story with an 'is blocked by' link.

steps.title: Complete the tracking fields on every blocker
steps.sop: The Scrum Master ensures each blocker in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps has: a linked blocking issue, an owner, a target resolution date, and a status. Done when no blocker lacks any of the four fields.
steps.verify: Audit the blockers in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if every blocking link shows linked issue, owner, target date, and status populated.

steps.title: Resolve or waive each blocking link
steps.sop: The Backend Developer and UI Developer work each blocking issue in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps to resolution before planning; a story is 'Ready' only when all its blocking links are resolved or explicitly waived with justification. Done when every candidate's links are resolved or waived.
steps.verify: Trace the blocker links on candidate stories in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if each link is resolved or carries an explicit waiver with justification, and only compliant stories show 'Ready'.

steps.title: Verify zero open blockers at commitment
steps.sop: The Scrum Master reconciles the blocker-link report to the candidate story list in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps at sprint commitment. Done when the count of open blockers on committed stories is 0 or every remaining one has a documented waiver.
steps.verify: Re-run the blocker report at commitment in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if zero unresolved blocking links exist on committed stories, or each shows a documented waiver.

steps.title: Descope or escalate unresolved blockers
steps.sop: The Scrum Master descopes any story whose blocker cannot be cleared before planning, or escalates the blocker as a Jira 'SDLC-Exception' in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps owned by the Scrum Master with a same-sprint remediation SLA. Done when every unresolved blocker is either descoped or escalated.
steps.verify: Search 'SDLC-Exception' tickets in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps; pass if each uncleared blocker maps to a descoped story or an exception owned by the Scrum Master with a same-sprint SLA.

steps.title: Save the dependency snapshot with confirmation
steps.sop: The Scrum Master saves a versioned, timestamped dependency-status snapshot to the sprint planning record and confirms the commitment is clean; blocker resolution history remains in Jira; Jira Align / Rally; Azure DevOps issue links and comments. Done when the snapshot and confirmation are recorded.
steps.verify: Open the sprint planning record; pass if the dependency snapshot exists with version and timestamp and the Scrum Master's confirmation of zero open blockers is recorded.

steps.title: Triage the integration defect population by severity
steps.sop: The Integration Engineer triages all open defects with type 'Defect' and phase label 'Integration Test' for the release fix version in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira), applying the materiality rule: Critical/High are release-blocking (fix or formally waive), Medium fix-or-defer with sign-off, Low to backlog. Done when every defect has a severity-based routing.
steps.verify: Run the Integration Test defect query for the fix version in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if every defect is classified and routed per the Critical/High/Medium/Low materiality rule.

steps.title: Populate the diagnostic fields on each defect
steps.sop: The Integration Engineer populates each defect in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira) with reproduction steps, environment, and a root-cause note per defect-management SOP v1.3. Done when no worked defect lacks these fields.
steps.verify: Audit the in-cycle defects in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if each carries reproduction steps, environment, and a root-cause note.

steps.title: Raise the fix pull request for each defect
steps.sop: The Backend Developer or UI Developer implements the fix and raises a PR in the source code/CI-CD repository referencing the defect key; expected behavior is judged against the integration contract/API spec (OpenAPI) version pinned for the release and the linked acceptance criteria. Done when every in-cycle defect has a linked PR.
steps.verify: Open each defect's linked PR in the source code/CI-CD repository; pass if the PR exists, references the defect key, and targets the release branch.

steps.title: Run the integration test suites in CI
steps.sop: The Integration Engineer runs targeted plus regression integration tests and contract tests in the source code/CI-CD repository CI for each fix; any fix touching more than 200 changed lines or a shared integration contract triggers the full integration regression run, not just the targeted test. Done when all runs are green.
steps.verify: Open the CI runs in the source code/CI-CD repository; pass if targeted, regression, and contract tests are green, and oversized or contract-touching fixes show a full regression run.

steps.title: Complete the closure fields with evidence attached
steps.sop: The Software Engineer populates the 'Root Cause' and 'Fix Commit' fields on each defect in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira) — the workflow blocks 'Closed' until both are populated — and attaches the fix PR, CI run id, and re-test result; pipeline logs are retained with timestamp and commit SHA. Done when every closing defect has fields and evidence complete.
steps.verify: Open each closed defect in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if 'Root Cause' and 'Fix Commit' are populated and the PR, CI run id, and re-test result are attached.

steps.title: Reconcile fixed defects to verification runs
steps.sop: The Integration Engineer reconciles in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira): the count of defects marked 'Fixed' equals the count with a linked merged PR and a passing re-test result. Done when 0 defects are closed without a linked verification run; a failed re-test reopens the defect and blocks the release build.
steps.verify: Compare the 'Fixed' count to the verified count in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if the counts match and no closed defect lacks a linked passing verification.

steps.title: Disposition deferred defects with approvals
steps.sop: The Integration Engineer dispositions defects that cannot be fixed in-cycle as 'Deferred' in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira) with a risk note and Release Manager approval, records each as a known-issue in the release notes, and files the 'SDLC-Exception' Jira ticket approved by the Engineering Manager; unresolved Critical/High escalate to the Release Manager. Done when every deferral is fully dispositioned.
steps.verify: Review 'Deferred' defects in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if each has a risk note, recorded approval, a release-notes known-issue entry, and an approved 'SDLC-Exception'.

steps.title: Confirm the exit criteria at the release gate
steps.sop: The Integration Engineer confirms the exit criteria in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira): 0 open Critical/High defects at the release gate (fixed or formally waived), and records the cycle sign-off. Done when the gate confirmation is recorded.
steps.verify: Run the open Critical/High query for the fix version in ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Jira); pass if it returns zero unwaived defects and the Integration Engineer's gate sign-off is recorded.

steps.title: Identify the superseded documents in Confluence
steps.sop: The Software Engineer reviews the initiative/system documentation set in Confluence at the release close-out cycle and lists every page or artifact that is superseded or obsolete and has a newer replacement. Done when the superseded list is complete for the review cycle.
steps.verify: Open the superseded list against the Confluence spaces; pass if every listed doc has an identified newer replacement and no known-obsolete page is missing from the list.

steps.title: Redirect inbound links before archiving
steps.sop: The Software Engineer redirects links from active content to the replacement doc in Confluence before archiving each page; unresolved references are logged as Jira 'Doc-Cleanup' items with an owner and a 10-business-day SLA, and docs with unresolved inbound links are held (not archived). Done when every to-be-archived page has zero unredirected inbound links or a hold with a cleanup item.
steps.verify: Check the inbound-link report for each page in Confluence; pass if links from active content are redirected, and every held page has a 'Doc-Cleanup' item with owner and SLA date.

steps.title: Tag each page with the archive metadata
steps.sop: The Software Engineer tags each superseded page in Confluence as 'Archived' with a replacement reference (link to the current doc) and a sunset date set to the release close date plus the standard 12-month archive retention; the page-property report enforces these three fields. Done when all three fields are set on every archived page.
steps.verify: Run the page-property report in Confluence; pass if every archived page shows the 'Archived' tag, a working replacement link, and a sunset date equal to release close plus 12 months.

steps.title: Move the archived pages to the Archive space
steps.sop: The Software Engineer moves each tagged page to the Confluence 'Archive' space, with the page history preserving archiver, date, page version, and replacement link. Done when no superseded page remains in an active space.
steps.verify: Browse the Confluence 'Archive' space; pass if every archived page resides there and its history records the archive action with version, actor, and date.

steps.title: Archive the superseded repo docs via commit
steps.sop: The Software Engineer moves superseded files under /docs in the source code/CI-CD repository to the archive location via a commit, providing the timestamped trail; where archived docs describe data entities or interfaces, the replacement reference points to the current source of truth (data catalog / OpenAPI spec). Done when the commit lands with all repo-side supersessions moved.
steps.verify: Open the archive commit in the source code/CI-CD repository; pass if all superseded /docs files were moved in it and replacement references point at the current spec of record.

steps.title: Reconcile the archive set to the identified list
steps.sop: The Software Engineer reconciles the count of docs identified as superseded to the count archived with replacement reference and sunset date, and verifies the link graph shows 0 inbound links to each archived doc at close. Done when the counts match and no archived doc has an unredirected inbound link.
steps.verify: Compare the identified list to the archived set and re-run the inbound-link check; pass if the counts are equal, 0 superseded docs remain in active spaces without a redirect, and each archived doc has zero inbound links.

steps.title: Record completion with escalation of stragglers
steps.sop: The Software Engineer records the review-cycle completion on the close-out page in Confluence, targeting 100% of superseded docs correctly archived; any doc whose links remain broken for more than 10 business days is escalated per the 'Doc-Cleanup' path. Done when the completion record is saved.
steps.verify: Open the close-out record in Confluence; pass if it states the archived total matching the identified total and any open 'Doc-Cleanup' item older than 10 business days shows an escalation.
